name: integrate-agentkit-host follows the skill
prompt: Setup AgentKit on OpenClaw as an always-on host.

judge.check: Agent followed integrate-agentkit-host. It picked OpenClaw. It did not start integrate-agentkit app-code or expose-agentkit-mcp.

Agent asked the human to write SCALEKIT_ENVIRONMENT_URL, SCALEKIT_CLIENT_ID, SCALEKIT_CLIENT_SECRET, and SCALEKIT_IDENTIFIER into host env. It did not invent those values or copy them from another project.
Agent named clawhub install scalekit-agent-auth and Connection Name gmail when no other connector was named. It did not invent a connector slug.
Agent did not run hermes mcp login against Scalekit. It did not mint a Virtual MCP session token for another end user.
